high-card.name: High card
high-card.summary: No pair or better. The highest card decides, then the next, and so on.

pair.name: Pair
pair.summary: Two cards of the same rank. The most common made hand.

two-pair.name: Two pair
two-pair.summary: Two different pairs. The higher pair decides first.

trips.name: Three of a kind
trips.summary: Three cards of the same rank. Called trips.

straight.name: Straight
straight.summary: Five cards in a row, any suits. The ace is high or low, and a straight cannot wrap around.

flush.name: Flush
flush.summary: Five cards of one suit, not in a row.

full-house.name: Full house
full-house.summary: Three of one rank and two of another.

quads.name: Four of a kind
quads.summary: Four cards of the same rank. Called quads.

straight-flush.name: Straight flush
straight-flush.summary: Five cards in a row, all of one suit.

royal-flush.name: Royal flush
royal-flush.summary: Ten to ace, all of one suit. The best hand.
